changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to full canonical forms (CNN/DailyMail instead of CNNDM), removed models mentioned only in passing (BART-Large, GPT-3), and added BERT-SumAbs which was explicitly listed as a baseline
Consolidated ROUGE variants into base ROUGE metric as per normalization guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper; LLMs were used only for generation and rationale extraction
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper; only automatic metrics were used for evaluation

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on abstractive text summarization using a novel distillation approach (TriSum) that extracts structured rationales from LLMs to train smaller models. Evaluation was conducted using standard automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore, BARTScore) but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation was performed. The main contribution is the distillation framework rather than evaluation methodology innovation.
